content_sections.heading: NBPGR Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NBPGR Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NBPGR Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Master's Degree in Science (Plant Pathology/ Entomology/ Nematology/ Agricultural Biotechnology/ Microbiology/ Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology/ Plant Genetic Resources/ Life Sciences from a recognized University) with 4 years / 5 years of Bachelor's Degree Or Candidates having a post-graduate degree in Basic Sciences (with specialization in Biotechnology/ Agriculture/ Botany/ Genetics/ plant science/ Life sciences/ related subject) with 3 years of Bachelor's degree and 2 years of Master's degree should have NET qualifications and 2 years of research experience in the relevant area. Laboratory Assistant: B.Sc./ Graduate degree in science with relevant experience in agriculture field, biotechnology laboratory, plant protection, growing crops etc. (Desirable).

content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Maximum 35 years. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NBPGR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR) for temporary research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Laboratory Assistant, with a total of 3 vacancies across these designations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application mode is via email advance copy followed by a walk-in interview. Selection is done through a walk-in interview in physical mode and document verification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 23 October 2026, which is also the deadline for submitting the advance copy of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for SRF?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in Science, Life Sciences, Agricultural Biotechnology, or related disciplines with NET qualifications and 2 years of relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Laboratory Assistant?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Laboratory Assistant position must hold a B.Sc. or Graduate degree in science from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for SRF and Laboratory Assistant?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and 50 years for Laboratory Assistant, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: SRF receives Rs. 37,000/- + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA thereafter. Laboratory Assistants receive Rs. 20,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the advertised posts.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send the advance copy of their application?
faq.answer: Candidates should send their advance copy of application along with scanned copies of necessary certificates via email to [email protected] by 23 October 2026.
